sql: WITH ranked_skills AS (SELECT family, family_label, skill, share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY family ORDER BY share DESC) AS rn FROM mart_skill_demand WHERE scope = 'all') SELECT family, family_label, skill, share FROM ranked_skills WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY family, rn
